method: Independent model cross-review of all 142 exact SPEC-proposed sense/hash/frame/profile combinations against every supplied source sense and context. Prior standards alternatives were not substituted or automatically merged. Approved aspect modes are explicit subsets of the proposal. Unrestricted ordinary profiles are not licensed merely by a context label: source readings with mandatory weather/vessel/plant/animal/liquid/text subject constraints are withheld pending a reviewed restricted-subject renderer. Conventional vessel-crew set-sail usage remains a normal human-capable lexical construction, not imagined personified weather. Source-specific notes apply only to the proposed selected meaning, never another prior sense. Qualified tear overrides were independently checked against pinned AGID rip evidence; no other irregular override is introduced. This is original model quality review, not source quotation or native-human certification, and approvals do not establish rendered-word coverage.

rejected.reason: Selected crop-flattening sense restricts the cause to wind/rain. Ordinary profile would wrongly render ACAMÉ as I flattened. Withheld until a restricted nonhuman cause-subject renderer is reviewed.
Exact frozen frame use up completely requires an object before the final completeness modifier in ordinary transitive use; do not authorize a malformed head-only clause.
Exact transitive sprinkle with sand omits the coated target inside the frozen instrument frame; use an independently reviewed object-safe construction instead.
Selected arfar sense requires a vessel as subject. Ordinary profile supplies unrestricted human and formal-you clauses; weather/nautical context cannot repair them.
Selected static assonant-rhyme sense has words/verses as subjects; ordinary human rhyme clauses can describe creating poetry instead. Restricted entity subject support is required.
Selected baldar source specifies disease/accident as the cause of limb disability. Ordinary unrestricted human-agent clauses are not licensed by that selected definition.
Selected refloating sense requires a previously grounded vessel as subject; ordinary unrestricted human clauses are not source-supported.
Selected sprouting sense requires a plant/shoot subject; ordinary human-subject clauses are unsupported by this exact botanical reading.
Selected boiling sense is intransitive heated liquid. Human I boil could imply causatively boiling a patient; the ordinary profile changes subject roles.
Selected static dip sense requires a geological seam/layer subject, not unrestricted human actors.
Selected spreading sense is intransitive liquid/quantity propagation. Ordinary I spread suggests a causal human spreading a patient, not this selected subject.
Selected florar sense requires a plant/tree producing flowers; ordinary human-subject clauses are not licensed.
Selected fruit-production sense requires a plant/tree, not a human actor or an imported figurative-result sense.
Selected seed/grain development has a plant subject. Human I produce grains implies farming/production rather than the plant developing seeds.
Causative make firm needs its target between make and firm; head-only inflection loses the object slot or changes the subject to the thing becoming firm.
Selected snout-digging sense requires an animal with a snout. Current unrestricted human subject profile needs a separately reviewed animal/entity restriction.
Selected huevar sense requires a bird beginning egg laying. Ordinary first/second-person human clauses are unsupported.
Selected humar emission sense would render I smoke, which normally describes tobacco consumption; retained smoke-emission context does not fix the subject/sense collision.
Selected latir means a dog barking, not a person making or imitating a bark; ordinary unrestricted human subjects require unsupported personification.
Selected pending state concerns a dispute or matter; ordinary I am pending/he is pending clauses are not source-faithful subject mappings.
Selected piaffe/stamping sense requires a horse moving its forelegs; unrestricted human stamping changes the selected animal reading.
Selected intransitive drip sense has liquid as its subject; unrestricted person clauses are not established by this source/context.
Exact proposal selects wind turning in direction. Ordinary unrestricted human veering clauses cannot be justified by that selected wind context; no broader prior sense is imported.
Spanish semantic evidence says display a rose color, a static property; proposed turn pink asserts an inchoative color change. The combined showing-or-acquiring context does not resolve the mismatch.
Exact proposal selects an animal crunching grass/food. Ordinary human subjects would broaden that selected reading; the different Ecuador general-chewing sense is not automatically imported.
Pack tight is not a sufficiently reliable frozen transitive frame here: the packed target normally intervenes before tight, and an intransitive group-packing reading changes the construction.
Address with tú requires an addressee between address and with; frozen tail lacks that middle object slot.
Selected be-urgent state concerns an action or need; unrestricted I am urgent/formal-you clauses do not preserve the source subject.
Selected versar sense has a book, speech or conversation concerning a topic. I deal with would instead suggest a human handling a matter.
Address with vos requires an addressee between address and with; frozen tail lacks that middle object slot.
Exact proposal selects a duck’s call; unrestricted human quacking would be imitation or another meaning not independently established here.
Channel surf is a compound predicate with surf as its verbal head; first-token inflection would produce he channels surf or I channeled surf. Exact proposed frame not supported by this renderer.
